lessons.title: Project Setup & Architecture
lessons.description: Plan the full‑stack blog, install dependencies, set up Prisma with models, and configure NextAuth.

lessons.title: Building the Blog Pages
lessons.description: Create the public blog list, post detail, and category pages using App Router, Prisma, and Static Generation with ISR.

lessons.title: Comments & Authentication
lessons.description: Add user comments to posts using NextAuth‑protected Server Actions and real‑time revalidation.

lessons.title: Styling, Images & SEO
lessons.description: Polish the UI with Tailwind, add responsive images with next/image, and implement full metadata for every page.

lessons.title: Deployment & Final Checklist
lessons.description: Deploy the blog to Vercel, set up CI/CD, monitor performance, and ensure everything is production‑ready.
